newsitem.title: JORDAN: King Hussein to meet Mubarak in Egypt on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: King Hussein to meet Mubarak in Egypt on Tuesday.

text.p: King Hussein of Jordan will hold talks with Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak in the Sinai resort of Sharm el-Sheikh on Tuesday to discuss the stalled Middle East peace process, a Jordanian official said on Monday.
He said the decision to hold the previously unplanned meeting was made in a telephone call between the two leaders.

King Hussein, regarded as Israel's strongest Arab ally since Jordan signed a peace treaty with the Jewish state in 1994, expressed anxiety about renewed violence in the region if Israel does not honour its peace accords with the Palestinians.
